narration:1:1521812001:1.text: Here and now, with you as witness, Kordan and Abundius finally put an end to the war. Their truce is official.
narration:1:1521812001:1.male: Here and now, with you as witness, Kordan and Abundius finally put an end to the war. Their truce is official.
narration:1:1521812001:1.female: Here and now, with you as witness, Kordan and Abundius finally put an end to the war. Their truce is official.

narration:2:1521812002:1.text: And just like that, the bloodshed between the Wildborn and the Halians comes to a halt. No more blades, no more battles.

narration:3:1521812003:1.text: Kordan doesn't linger. Soon enough, he heads back to Wrathwood Grove.

narration:4:1521812004:1.text: While the troops ready their gear for the march, Abundius' gaze lingers on Perseus' shield. He seems lost in thought, his expression unreadable.

say:6:1521812006:1.text: Besides his shield, what else should we lay with Perseus?
say:6:1521812006:1.source_cn: 除了长枪和盾牌，还有什么能给珀尔修斯陪葬？

choice_prompt:7:1521812006.text: Besides his shield, what else should we lay with Perseus?
choice_prompt:7:1521812006.source_cn: 除了长枪和盾牌，还有什么能给珀尔修斯陪葬？

say:9:1521812008:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a powerful mage, right? Will you come with me back to Halia? I need to find something... for his burial.
say:9:1521812008:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a powerful mage, right? Will you come with me back to Halia? I need to find something... for his burial.
say:9:1521812008:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a powerful mage, right? Will you come with me back to Halia? I need to find something... for his burial.

say:10:1521812009:0.text: Perseus was a general of Halia, a student of Master Bakis... and one of my only friends. I want to give him a funeral worthy of who he was.
say:10:1521812009:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯是呼临城的统帅，也是比博老师的学生，是我的朋友...

choice_prompt:11:1521812009.text: Perseus was a general of Halia, a student of Master Bakis... and one of my only friends. I want to give him a funeral worthy of who he was.
choice_prompt:11:1521812009.source_cn: 珀尔修斯是呼临城的统帅，也是比博老师的学生，是我的朋友。我希望能给他一场配得上他的葬礼……

say:13:1521812012:0.text: Alright, let's <style="highlight">head back to Halia and look around</style>. I know Perseus used to visit <style="highlight">an old woman named Granny Alle</style>. Maybe she has something he left behind.
say:13:1521812012:0.source_cn: 那我们就先<style=highlight>回呼临城找...

say:14:1521812013:1.text: Wait, I can't go dressed like this...
say:14:1521812013:1.source_cn: 不过，呃，我不能穿着这身衣服去……

say:15:1521812014:1.text: I need to change into something more suitable. Give me a moment.
say:15:1521812014:1.source_cn: 我去换身衣服，很快就回来！

narration:16:1521812015:1.text: In no time, Abundius sheds his old clothes, slipping into the rough-spun garb of a commoner.

narration:17:1521812016:1.text: Together, you begin the trek to Halia.

say:19:1521812011:0.text: As long as it's not food, I'll give you anything you want.
say:19:1521812011:0.source_cn: 只要你要的不是食物，我可以给你很多报酬。
